item.title: Parking bay cones, 29th October
item.description:
Have these cones been authorised by the council? Otherwise I will remove them so that I can park for work as I usually would. They are causing huge issues for people like myself who rely on these 4 hour bays to provide parking for some of the working day. No visible signs to say why this space has been coned off preventing use. I suspect it has something to do with a company doing work on a block of flats up the road from these bays. They previously used scaffold poles and wood timbres to section off parking recently, however this was further up the road in the 2 hour bays.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hadlow Road, Longlands, Greater London
